description: NaGe₂N₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.79 Å. Ge⁴⁺ is bonded to four N³⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing GeN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ge-N bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.88 Å. There are two inequivalent N³⁻ sites. In the first N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Ge⁴⁺ atoms. In the second N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded to one Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Ge⁴⁺ atoms to form corner-sharing NNaGe₃ trigonal pyramids.
